moves.name: Down bounce
moves.note: Weight drops into the floor on the beat; the classic hip-hop pocket.

moves.name: Funk rock
moves.note: Torso rocks back on the beat and forward on the 'and'.

moves.name: House jack
moves.note: Chest pumps in a wave through the body, slightly ahead of the upbeat.

moves.name: Two-sided sway
moves.note: Low-energy weight shift; what a dancer does while finding the groove.

moves.name: Two-step
moves.note: Step out, close in, other side.

moves.name: Kick ball change
moves.note: Kick on the 'and', ball on the 'a', change on the beat: built for syncopation.

moves.name: Heel-toe swivel
moves.note: Toes fan in and out; the body glides.

moves.name: Body roll
moves.note: Sustained wave from head to hips.

moves.name: Spin
moves.note: Full turn, landing on the 'and' of 2.

moves.name: Hit and freeze
moves.note: Saved for drops and big accents.

moves.name: Check-in
moves.note: Turn toward the partner and nod together; yaw is mirrored toward wherever they are.

moves.name: Call and answer clap
moves.note: Answer the partner's phrase with syncopated claps.
